card.name: Concentration figures in acid dilution
card.fires_on: Tokens just before or inside a concentration number for hydrochloric acid or similar solutions, such as the gap before 36% or the parenthesis before ~11.6N. Weaker hits fall partway through proper names.

modes.label: Acid strength figures
modes.description: Spaces, parentheses, decimal points or N after a strength value in an acid dilution or concentration range.

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: Middle pieces of place or person names, split across tokens.
modes.example: Mongolia, U<<lan>> Bator, City of Fairfield

card.plain: It fires on the numbers describing how strong an acid solution is, and occasionally in the middle of proper names.
